messages:
alexa: starting cutover for feature-flag lr-opt-3. plan includes shadow mirroring, short hold for migration, then phased enable. change window 01:30-03:00 UTC. please ack.
deploy-bot: preflight ok: infra checks pass, GPUs available 420 units, model pinned: model-routing v4.0.1, smoke-tests: green. canary id: canary-419001. dashboard: https://dash/release/canary-419001
matt: ack. quick Q — does this include the small write-path migration we discussed? we should avoid write schema changes during roll.
sophia: write migration scheduled after rollout. this flag only touches inference routing and caching. read-index migration applied earlier today.
oncall: ack - i'll stand watch. alert thresholds set: p95 latency > 900ms OR error-rate > 0.8% => auto-fail.
alexa: rollout plan:
```
- 01:35 UTC: enable shadow mirror (20% mirrored traffic)
- 10m validation: metrics + sampled outputs
- 01:50 UTC: enable live at 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 100% (hold 4m between steps)
- if any hold condition met, rollback to previous route version
```
matt: instrumented eval hooks ready? need per-prompt sampling and the QA set checks.
deploy-bot: shadow jobs are running. sample checks: style/precision within thresholds for 300 samples.
jordan: I'll watch traces and open LiveToken if we see spikes. setting early latency warn to 820ms.
alexa: note: cold-start noise expected for first 90s due to KV warm-up. target cache hit rate > 80% before moving past 2%.
oncall: we'll gate advance until cache hit >80% and error-rate <0.3% for 2 consecutive minutes.
deploy-bot: rolling live to 2% now (slice s-202). ETA 45s.
matt: seeing +80ms p50 bump, p95 stable. holding at 2%.
sophia: GPU mem and host swaps look normal.
jordan: sampled eval pass 287/300. logging one hallucination case -> INF-4907.
alexa: product reviewed flagged case; acceptable. proceed to 8% in 4m if no alerts.
deploy-bot: live ramp to 8% complete.
alexa: proceed with 25% at 02:10 and full at 02:30, unless auto-fail triggers. Keep channel updated.
oncall: rollback conditions: p95 > 1100ms, error-rate > 1.5%, or >3 regressions in sampled window.
product: thumbs up on quality. watching user-visible metrics.
matt: reminder: if we rollback, run `/deploy drain-routing s-202 --wait 120` before switching variants to avoid dupes.
alexa: rollback command if needed:
`/deploy rollback model-routing v4.0.0 --reason "lr-opt-3-rollback"`
deploy-bot: scheduled freeze window for config changes during ramp. automation will abort any config writes.
jordan: starting LiveToken for quick capture: /livetoken start lr-opt-3
alexa: thanks team. i'll close thread after 100% or rollback complete. :white_check_mark:
